mapper.insert: INSERT INTO approval_document (document_type, title, content, amount, start_date, end_date, drafter_id) VALUES (#{documentType}, #{title}, #{content}, #{amount}, #{startDate}, #{endDate}, #{drafterId})
mapper.select: SELECT d.id, d.document_type, d.title, d.content, d.amount, d.start_date, d.end_date, d.drafter_id, d.created_at, e.name AS drafter_name FROM approval_document d JOIN employee e ON e.id = d.drafter_id WHERE d.id = #{id}

SELECT d.id, d.document_type, d.title, d.content, d.amount, d.start_date, d.end_date, d.drafter_id, d.created_at, e.name AS drafter_name FROM approval_document d JOIN employee e ON e.id = d.drafter_id WHERE d.drafter_id = #{drafterId} ORDER BY d.created_at DESC, d.id DESC

SELECT DISTINCT d.id, d.document_type, d.title, d.content, d.amount, d.start_date, d.end_date, d.drafter_id, d.created_at, e.name AS drafter_name FROM approval_document d JOIN employee e ON e.id = d.drafter_id JOIN approval_step s ON s.document_id = d.id WHERE s.approver_employee_id = #{employeeId} ORDER BY d.created_at DESC, d.id DESC
